cohort: 92 term nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies in the second stage of labor
finding: Asynclitism was present in 15% of nulliparous women in the second stage of labor and was more common in non-occiput anterior positions, smaller changes in head perineum distance, and showed a trend towards more operative deliveries.
mod_finding: Women with asynclitism showed a trend towards more operative deliveries compared to those without asynclitism, although this difference was not statistically significant.
